name: Harmonie
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on a scenic hillside in Soelden, Haus Harmonie features tastefully decorated apartments. Guests appreciate relaxing privacy alongside breathtaking alpine vistas.

The Gaislachkogl and Giggijoch cable cars, village amenities, and hiking trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Appartementhaus Harmonie in Soelden provides contemporary comfort and mountain serenity in Oetztal.
